candidates.title: Telangana farmers protest over power cuts, demand uninterrupted electricity supply
candidates.excerpt: Farmers in Palamuru, Nizamabad and Suryapet districts staged protests at electricity substations on Sunday, demanding quality and uninterrupted power supply. They said power disruptions and inadequate canal water were threatening crops and adding to the burden of cultivation loans.

candidates.title: KTR urges Revanth Reddy to expedite JNTU Sircilla campus
candidates.excerpt: BRS working president KT Rama Rao urged Chief Minister A Revanth Reddy to expedite construction of the JNTU Engineering College campus in Rajanna Sircilla district. He sought the release of funds and protection against eviction until construction or alternative arrangements are completed.
